performance.full_traffic: See traffic-summary.json. New/cached flows and rates are separate. LAN IPv4 direct TCP new-flow TC work decreased about14-17% in these fixtures, while end-to-end latency moved in both directions; no whole-engine latency or throughput improvement is claimed.

limits: Finite scenarios do not prove arbitrary policies; assembler jump/instruction limits and kernel verifier complexity remain independent rejection boundaries.
Randomized working set exceeds LLC; it is cache-pressure evidence, not proof that every CPU/JIT/map access is cold.
Raw loader timing is descriptive, not a controlled paired reload benchmark; maximum mixed-policy verifier/JIT cost increases materially.
Traffic uses controlled synthetic64-per-class fact chains, local SOCKS5 upstream and namespace HTTP/UDP/DNS targets, not production config.dae/real geo-asset or physical NIC throughput A/B.
ARM lacks GRE driver; real TUN interfaces with an isolated packet-copy bridge exercise L3. Its bridge affects end-to-end latency, not the separately reported kernel TC counters.
Custom traffic disables NFQUEUE; the independent real NFQUEUE/nftables gates passed. TCP block is checked as no forwarded application data, not failure to complete a TPROXY handshake.

The virtme outer launcher returned255 after powerdown although guest commands completed successfully and printed CSE_VM_GATES_PASS; guest logs and result files, not launcher status, establish those passes.

Lab binaries were manually built with stable/release/musl/default+ebpf and are not release tarballs. They were built before commit metadata/formatting-only cleanup; recorded source and bytecode equivalence bind the measured implementation.
baseline.json is a frozen initial-capture record; its initial local-only scope predates the user's later explicit shared-lab authorization.
reproduction: Check out the reviewed_head in a separate honk worktree. In this evidence directory, create candidate-source as a symlink to that worktree and set HONK_WORKTREE to its absolute path.

For real EXT statistics/publication rejection, append #[path="/absolute/evidence/root_probe.rs"] mod root_probe; and the analogous publication_probe.rs module only to the disposable reviewed worktree's ebpf/real/routing/tests.rs. Build its ebpf-feature library test runner and routing-test object; invoke the ignored mixed_extension_statistics/publisher_verifier_rejection cases with HONK_ROUTING_TEST_OBJECT and the matching HONK_CSE_EXT_RESULTS/HONK_CSE_PUBLICATION_RESULTS output paths.

Traffic runners and exact snapshots are under traffic/<host-layer>/. Reuse only on authorized lab hosts after validating original-service guards; never overwrite installed engine binaries. Inputs/arm binary hashes are retained in each results.json and lab-build-manifest.json.
